# OLF DSL Knowledge Base

> A knowledge base for generating myViewBoard `.olf` files. **Default path: build
> the file yourself, right now, in your own code-execution sandbox** — write
> Python using the standard library (`json`, `zipfile`, `uuid`) to construct
> `content.json` and zip it into a `.olf`, following the element semantics in
> `spec/`+`elements/` and the mechanical rules in `constraints/`. Most readers of
> this repo are plain Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini chat users with no external tool
> access, so that's the assumed default, not a fallback. An MCP tool wrapping the
> real engine, if one happens to be available, is preferred when reachable — see
> `CORE.md` for the full priority order.

Read in this order: `CORE.md` first (reading order + generation-path rules), then
`spec/dsl-spec.md`, then only the `elements/*.md` files relevant to the current
request, then any matching `constraints/*.md` files, then a worked `examples/*.yaml`
for few-shot grounding.

## Core

- [CORE.md](CORE.md) — start here always. Reading order, what this DSL can and
  cannot do yet, and the generation-path rule (produce a spec, not a zip).
- [spec/dsl-spec.md](spec/dsl-spec.md) — the DSL grammar: document structure,
  templates, positioning, layers, the engine contract, CLI/MCP interface.
- [spec/content-json-envelope.md](spec/content-json-envelope.md) — **read this
  in full before writing any JSON, every time, no exceptions.** The root
  `olf`/`pageset`/`page` structure every element sits inside. A file can have
  every element correct and still fail to open if this is wrong — confirmed by
  a real test.

- [spec/starter-helpers.md](spec/starter-helpers.md) — **default build method.**
  Paste-ready stdlib-only Python helpers + a validator you run before delivering:
  [starter/olf_starter.py](starter/olf_starter.py) (always),
  [starter/olf_starter_extras.py](starter/olf_starter_extras.py) (tables, images,
  animation, links), [starter/olf_starter_svg.py](starter/olf_starter_svg.py)
  (only for SVG icons/shapes/images), [starter/olf_validate.py](starter/olf_validate.py) (always,
  fix until PASS). Fetch them as raw text and paste verbatim into your sandbox.
- [examples/water-cycle-full.md](examples/water-cycle-full.md) — complete 3-page
  worked example: [starter/example_build.py](starter/example_build.py) →
  [examples/water_cycle_full.content.json](examples/water_cycle_full.content.json).

## Elements (Layer 2 — what a spec's `elements:` list can contain)

- [elements/text.md](elements/text.md) — `text:`, role presets, RTF/alignment rules
- [elements/bullets.md](elements/bullets.md) — `bullets:`, the compound list element
- [elements/shape.md](elements/shape.md) — `shape:`, the full shape-kind catalog
- [elements/line-and-curve.md](elements/line-and-curve.md) — `line:` and `curve:`
- [elements/image.md](elements/image.md) — `image:`
- [elements/table.md](elements/table.md) — `table:`, merges, the three index spaces
- [elements/animate-and-link.md](elements/animate-and-link.md) — `animate:` and
  `link:` attributes (attach to any element above except `bullets`)
- [elements/ai-pen.md](elements/ai-pen.md) — `AI-pen`: true-vector SVG icons,
  custom shapes, rounded-rect cards (starter helper: `starter/olf_starter_svg.py`)
- [elements/svg-image.md](elements/svg-image.md) — SVG as an `image` element:
  what renders, what fails (`<text>`, `<pattern>`, `<use>`, animation), the 8x rule
- [elements/raw-passthrough.md](elements/raw-passthrough.md) — `raw:`, the Layer-3
  escape hatch, and its mechanical safety checks

## Constraints (ground-truth facts that override intuition or the official spec)

- [constraints/font-size-and-pixels.md](constraints/font-size-and-pixels.md)
- [constraints/width-factor-and-line-pitch.md](constraints/width-factor-and-line-pitch.md)
- [constraints/text-wrapping-and-overlap.md](constraints/text-wrapping-and-overlap.md) —
  **read before placing any textarea** — how to estimate wrapped line count and
  height without real font metrics, to avoid overlapping the next element
- [constraints/max-font-size-cap.md](constraints/max-font-size-cap.md)
- [constraints/text-color-two-fields.md](constraints/text-color-two-fields.md)
- [constraints/table-index-spaces.md](constraints/table-index-spaces.md)
- [constraints/curve-stroke-opacity.md](constraints/curve-stroke-opacity.md) —
  a `curve` with no explicit `stroke-opacity` renders invisible
- [constraints/raw-element-mechanical-checks.md](constraints/raw-element-mechanical-checks.md)
- [constraints/android-vs-windows-divergence.md](constraints/android-vs-windows-divergence.md)
- [constraints/ai-pen-path-rules.md](constraints/ai-pen-path-rules.md) —
  **read before using any SVG path in AI-pen**: allowed commands, non-negative
  coords, the donut-hole trap, how to vet a stock icon
- [constraints/ai-pen-color-format.md](constraints/ai-pen-color-format.md)
- [constraints/font-portability.md](constraints/font-portability.md)
- [constraints/deferred-features-not-in-dsl.md](constraints/deferred-features-not-in-dsl.md) —
  read this before promising flashcard, poll, or AI-pen-icon support

## Patterns

- [patterns/common-patterns.md](patterns/common-patterns.md) — worked page patterns
  (title+bullets+caption, mixed layers, coordinate-free lesson pages)

## Examples (worked DSL specs — use these for few-shot, not just the schema)

- [examples/minimal.yaml](examples/minimal.yaml) — smallest valid file
- [examples/water_cycle.yaml](examples/water_cycle.yaml) — typical lesson page
- [examples/frog_life_cycle.yaml](examples/frog_life_cycle.yaml) — multi-page,
  shapes + images
- [examples/tables_animation_links.yaml](examples/tables_animation_links.yaml) —
  merged table + animation + page links together
